classDefinitions.expect_actual: Every top-level expect declaration (function, class, object) to each of its actual declarations; members of expect classes are covered by their class.
classDefinitions.kotlin_calls_java: Every use in Kotlin source of a workspace Java declaration: supertype, constructor call, override, static call, instance call, synthetic property access, SAM conversion.
classDefinitions.java_calls_kotlin: Every use in Java source of a workspace Kotlin declaration: property getter, const, object INSTANCE call, file-facade (...Kt) call, static @JvmStatic call, enum constant.
classDefinitions.manifest_component_to_class: Every manifest component element (application, activity, activity-alias, service, receiver, provider) of every module manifest to its implementing class.
classDefinitions.layout_class_reference: Every workspace class named by fully qualified name in a layout or navigation XML file.
classDefinitions.resource_to_consumer: Complete for strings, dimens, colors, styles, drawables, layouts, menus and navigation graphs: each declaration to each Kotlin/Java/XML/manifest file that references it (R.type.name, @type/name, implicit style parent). Lines are 1-based. View binding use is a separate class.
classDefinitions.viewbinding_layout_to_consumer: Every layout with a generated binding class to each source file that names that binding class.
classDefinitions.compose_resource_to_consumer: Every Compose Multiplatform resource (string, drawable) to each Kotlin file that reads it through Res.*.
classDefinitions.aidl_interface_to_implementer: AIDL interface to each Stub implementation in Kotlin.
classDefinitions.aidl_interface_to_client: AIDL interface to each Kotlin class that holds or invokes it.
classDefinitions.aidl_method_to_override: Every AIDL method to its Stub override.
classDefinitions.aidl_parcelable_to_class: AIDL parcelable declaration to its Kotlin implementation.
classDefinitions.proto_message_to_consumer: Every proto message/enum to each Kotlin file using the generated type; usage 'inferred-type' marks files that use it without naming it.
classDefinitions.sq_query_to_consumer: Every .sq named query to each repository method that calls it.
classDefinitions.sq_table_to_consumer: Every .sq table to the files using its generated row type.
classDefinitions.room_entity_dao_database: Room entity, DAO and database triple and the exported schema file.
classDefinitions.room_component_to_consumer: Room DAO and database to the workspace code that uses or implements them.
classDefinitions.catalog_alias_to_module: Version-catalog library, bundle and plugin aliases to the modules using them, directly or through a convention plugin.
classDefinitions.convention_plugin_to_module: Every convention plugin to each module that applies it.
classDefinitions.jni_external_to_native: Every Kotlin external function to its C function.
classDefinitions.buildconfig_field_to_consumer: Every BuildConfig field used in source (custom and generated) to each class reading it.
classDefinitions.test_to_subject: Every test class to the primary class under test.
classDefinitions.flavor_specific_implementation: Flavor-specific implementations of one fully qualified name, from the shared interface and from the shared usage site, per flavor.
